name: Courier delivery, priced in florins
summary: One courier delivery to the door, open only to buyers and couriers who trade in florins.
description: A single order over the courier-delivery agreement, unchanged: the courier carries one order to the buyer's door, the arrival recorded under the hand-off clause, and both parties bond before the trip. One term is added. The designer pins the florin, the token that rewards the designers of clauses, agreements and processes, as the one token the order is priced and bonded in. Checkout writes the florin into the agreement, so no token picker appears. This is the designer's choice, not the protocol's: the courier-delivery agreement stays open to any ERC-20 token in every design that composes it without the pin.
